name: Git vault versioning
description: Tracks a vault or project with local Git commits in a host-rendered source control view.

gitExecutablePath.title: Git executable
gitExecutablePath.description: Absolute path to a Git executable. Leave empty to use the Git the host finds in its own fixed locations.

defaultBranch.title: Default branch
defaultBranch.description: Branch name used when you initialize a repository from Denote.

authorName.title: Commit author name
authorName.description: Optional name recorded on commits Denote creates. Leave empty to use the repository's own Git identity.

authorEmail.title: Commit author email
authorEmail.description: Optional email recorded on commits Denote creates. Leave empty to use the repository's own Git identity.

autoCommitIntervalMinutes.title: Automatic commit interval
autoCommitIntervalMinutes.description: Minutes between automatic local commits. Zero disables automatic commits. Automatic commits are not implemented yet.

autoCommitMessage.title: Automatic commit message
autoCommitMessage.description: Message used for automatic local commits once they are implemented.

includePatterns.title: Include patterns
includePatterns.description: Comma-separated relative path prefixes to track. Empty means the whole repository.

excludePatterns.title: Exclude patterns
excludePatterns.description: Comma-separated relative path prefixes to leave alone. Empty excludes nothing.
